name: Arc Reactor
author: Violet
font: Segoe UI Variable Display, Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif
css: .bg::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;background-image:linear-gradient(rgba(34,211,238,.06) 1px,transparent 1px),linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(34,211,238,.06) 1px,transparent 1px);background-size:32px 32px;-webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 40%,#000 30%,transparent 80%);animation:arcGrid 14s linear infinite}@keyframes arcGrid{to{background-position:0 32px,32px 0}}.bg::after{content:'';position:absolute;left:0;right:0;height:120px;top:-120px;pointer-events:none;background:linear-gradient(transparent,rgba(34,211,238,.08),transparent);animation:arcScan 7s linear infinite}@keyframes arcScan{to{top:110%}}.brand-name{letter-spacing:3px;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;color:#a5f3fc;text-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(34,211,238,.8)}.orb{background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%,#fff 0%,#a5f3fc 18%,#22d3ee 40%,#0e7490 70%,#03121c 100%)}.ring.r1,.ring.r2{border-width:2px}.widget-card,.input-wrap,.mem-card{border-color:rgba(34,211,238,.25)}.app.paused .bg::before,.app.paused .bg::after{animation-play-state:paused!important}.app.no-motion .bg::before,.app.no-motion .bg::after{animation:none!important}
